# The Training Yard — llms.txt
# https://trainingyarddsm.com
# Last updated: 2026-04-30

## Business Information
- **Name:** The Training Yard
- **Type:** Indoor Sports Training Facility
- **Location:** 1234 Sports Way, Des Moines, IA 50309
- **Phone:** (515) 555-0199
- **Email:** info@trainingyarddsm.com
- **Website:** https://trainingyarddsm.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM, Saturday–Sunday 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM

## Facility Specifications
- **Total Area:** 6,000 square feet (60 feet wide × 100 feet long)
- **Surface:** Premium synthetic turf rated for turf shoes (no metal cleats)
- **Batting Cages:** 4 professional-grade retractable batting cages with automated pitching machines
- **Configuration:** Cages retract to open the full 60' × 100' turf for soccer, agility, and team practices
- **Lighting:** Full LED high-bay lighting system
- **Parking:** Free on-site parking

## Services Offered
1. **Batting Cage Rentals** — Single cage, two-cage combo, or all four cages. Includes pitching machine, tee, balls, L-screen, and helmets.
2. **Turf Rentals** — Half turf or full 60' × 100' turf for team practices, drills, and conditioning.
3. **Private Lessons** — One-on-one instruction in hitting, pitching, fielding, and sport-specific skills. From $65/session.
4. **Youth Clinics & Camps** — Progressive multi-week programs in baseball, softball, soccer, and agility.
5. **Team Practice Blocks** — Seasonal contracts for club and travel teams needing guaranteed weekly turf time.
6. **Speed & Agility Training** — Ladder drills, cone work, shuttle runs, and SAQ programming.

## Sports Supported
- Baseball
- Softball
- Soccer / Futsal
- Agility & Speed Training
- Flag Football
- General Athletic Conditioning

## Pricing
### Walk-In Rates
- Single Cage, 30 min: $30
- Single Cage, 60 min: $50
- Half Turf, 60 min: $150
- Full Turf, 60 min: $250

### Membership Tiers
- **Individual Monthly:** $89/month — Off-peak cage access, 20% off peak rates, member-only open gym
- **Family Pass:** $149/month — Up to 4 family members, shared hours, 15% off clinics & camps
- **Seasonal Team Contract:** From $1,200/season — Guaranteed weekly prime-time full turf, 10–16 week commitment

### Programs
- Youth Hitting Clinic: $199/player, 6 weeks
- Softball Skills Camp: $179/player, 1 week
- Indoor Soccer Academy: $149/player, 8 weeks
- Speed & Agility Training: $129/player, 4 weeks

## Target Audience
- Youth athletes ages 6–18
- Club and travel baseball/softball teams
- Youth soccer teams needing indoor winter training
- High school athletes seeking year-round training
- Parents of multi-sport athletes
- Coaches and club directors

## Facility Configurations
The Training Yard's unique retractable cage system allows the space to transform between configurations:
1. **4 Cages Active** — All four batting cages deployed for maximum hitting stations
2. **2 Cages + Open Turf** — Two cages active with remaining space open for fielding or agility
3. **Team Practice Split** — Cages for hitting stations, open area for fielding/warm-ups
4. **Full Open Turf** — All cages retracted, full 60' × 100' field for soccer, agility, team practices

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Q: What sports can you train at The Training Yard?**
A: Baseball, softball, soccer, agility and speed training, flag football, and general conditioning.

**Q: How big is the facility?**
A: 6,000 square feet — 60 feet wide by 100 feet long of premium synthetic turf.

**Q: Can a team rent the whole turf?**
A: Yes. Full-turf rentals are available by the hour ($250/hr) or via seasonal team contracts.

**Q: Do members get discounts?**
A: Yes. All tiers include priority booking, discounted rates, and member-only sessions.

**Q: Are outside instructors allowed?**
A: Yes. They must sign a waiver and follow facility guidelines.

**Q: What ages is the facility best for?**
A: Youth athletes ages 6 through adult, with the sweet spot being 8–18.

**Q: What should players bring?**
A: Batting gear for cages, indoor shoes for turf (no metal cleats). We provide balls, tees, and nets.
